title: OrientationRow

enabled.description: The instructions.orientation key: whether runs are handed the block.

text.description: The block as the first run of a new session of the default account, started from a client, is handed it while the key is on, verification lines included; null while the environment holds no account.

unreadRegistries.description: The registries the block could not read in time, each rendered as could not be read.

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

label.description: An account's label: 1 to 200 characters on one line, with no space at either end; unique on its environment ignoring case, preset to the email the account signed in as.

kind.description: How an adapter delivers standing instructions to its provider: system-prompt-append (Claude), developer-instructions (Codex), prompt (a local model), or none.

maxCharacters.description: The most characters the channel carries; null when it has no cap.

channel.description: Its adapter's instruction channel: none is handed no standing instructions.

reason.description: Why its runs are handed no standing instructions; null while its adapter has an instruction channel.

items.description: An account of the environment, with its adapter's instruction channel and, without one, why its runs are handed no standing instructions.

accounts.description: The environment's accounts, in the account list's order.

description: The read-only Orientation row: the instructions.orientation key, the block as a run receives it, and the environment's accounts.
